name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Backfills last release's MediaStreams fix onto items that already existed before it: previously only newly-synced items got real codec/resolution/audio data saved (existing items only ever had their stream URL and duration refreshed, not this), so anything already in your library would have kept probing/transcoding until it happened to be deleted and recreated. Reconciliation now does a one-time backfill for any federated item that doesn't have stream data yet - no full resync or re-add needed, it self-heals on the next scheduled sync.

198 tests (unchanged).
